rules.text: No fixed return window for most merchandise (satisfaction guarantee).
rules.quote: We guarantee your satisfaction on every product we sell, and will refund your purchase price

rules.text: 90 days from the date the member received the item.
rules.quote: Costco will accept returns within 90 days (from the date the member received the merchandise)
rules.category: electronics (TVs, projectors, major appliances, computers, tablets, smart wearables, cameras, drones, camcorders, MP3 players, cell phones)

rules.text: Membership fee refundable at any time if dissatisfied.
rules.quote: We will cancel and refund your membership fee at any time if you are dissatisfied.

rules.text: Non-refundable: airline and live-event items, precious metals, Shop Cards, gift cards and tickets; custom/special-order items (warranty only); cigarettes and alcohol where prohibited by law.
Original IGI/GIA paperwork required; a Jewelry Credit Memo is issued pending gemologist inspection within 48 hours.
rules.quote: Members returning a diamond over 1.00ct must also present all original paperwork
